text: Aldrees' FY2024 board of directors includes three executives of Hassana Investment Company — Farraj Saad Al-Qabbani (Director of Alternative Investments Department), Basil Ali Al Faris (Director of International Listed Markets) and Mohamad Salem Ali Musa (Portfolio Manager). Hassana is the investment manager of Saudi Arabia's General Organization for Social Insurance (GOSI).
short: Three directors on Aldrees' board are executives of Hassana, GOSI's investment manager
